operator_notes: GitHub-sourced public Gitea (go-gitea/gitea) issue object authz modeling package. Faithful model of GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index} using repository-scoped GetIssueWithAttrsByIndex(repoID, index) plus Permission.CanReadIssuesOrPulls. Researcher may use self-hosted Gitea or static review only. Not a public gitea.com attack package. No real secrets. Report submission blocked; upstream disclosure path is security@gitea.io if ever needed.
